suite.name: Retail Guard Synthetic Generalization Diagnostic V1
suite.scope: Developer-authored synthetic scenarios separated from the frozen Baseline20 trajectories.

variants.description: Disable every blocking finding to form the synthetic no-Guard baseline.
Keep every runtime-safe Guard rule enabled.
Remove order-state eligibility checks for cancellation, return, and exchange.
Remove product/variant semantic checks, including same-option exchanges.
Remove the premature-transfer check when an actionable variant exists.

validity_notes: The source scenarios and expectations are developer-authored, not independently adjudicated human gold.
This is a finding-level deterministic counterfactual: it filters selected blocking findings and recomputes the decision.
Ablation results measure rule coverage on this synthetic suite, not online recovery, production precision, or general Retail performance.
No model calls, reference actions, gold database states, or official Tau2 test tasks are used.
